settings.signer: explicit disposable test-file provider, outside worktree
settings.cold_reset: fsync + POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on fixture/store/binary files; advisory, metadata and shared libraries not reset
settings.warm_reset: fresh identical repository copy; pre-read fixture/store/binary files; new CLI process each time
settings.ignore: no ignore files; all generated paths included
settings.storage: existing runtime defaults; no codec/packing changes; allocation includes file and directory blocks
settings.verification: restore --checkpoint ID --destination EMPTY_DIR after mutating live bytes; full manifest comparison outside timings
settings.history_preparation: capture N nodes; restore each to a separate directory; no navigation/proof metadata added to the fixture
